🖌️ Logo, Pamphlet & Business Card Design · Logan

Logo, Pamphlet & Business Card Design Logan. A Brand Worth Remembering.

Every business starts with an idea, but it becomes a brand with a look, a feel, and a strong first impression. Computer Repairs Logan helps bring that visual identity to life through professional design tailored for logos, pamphlets and business cards, no design jargon, just practical design made easy.

Design My Brand
✓ Unlimited Revisions
✓ Print & Digital Ready Files
✓ 3 to 5 Day Turnaround
✓ Full Usage Rights
Why It Matters

Every Business Starts With An Idea. Branding Makes It Real.

Every business starts with an idea, but it becomes a brand with a look, a feel, and a strong first impression. We help bring that visual identity to life through professional design tailored for logos, pamphlets and business cards, no design jargon, just practical design made easy.

Our Approach

Designed With You, Refined Until It's Right.

Computer Repairs Logan works closely with each client to create high-quality, personalised designs that reflect their brand and purpose. Whether you're starting from scratch or need to refresh your current branding, we'll guide you every step of the way.

What's Included

Logo, Pamphlet & Business Card Design.

🎨

Logo Design

100% original logo concepts based on your business goals, in modern, clean or traditional styles, delivered as transparent PNG, high-res JPG, PDF and vector (AI/EPS) for website, signage, print and merchandise.

📄

Pamphlet & Flyer Design

Single-sided and folded designs, laid out for readability and branding impact, ideal for product highlights, pricing lists, service features or event promotion, supplied print-ready and web-shareable.

💳

Business Card Design

Horizontal or vertical layouts, including personal details, logos and QR codes, ready for local or online printing, matching your existing brand or built fresh.

Who We Design For

Practical Design For Real Businesses.

  • Launching a new business. And need everything designed from scratch.
  • Rebranding. An outdated logo or printed collateral.
  • Trade shows or events. Needing pamphlets for a launch or promotion.
  • Networking. Needing business cards for meetings and referrals.
  • Freelancers or tradies. Wanting to stand out in a crowded market.
Why Choose Computer Repairs Logan

Not Designer Egos. Just Designs That Work.

  • Unlimited revisions. Until it's right, not just "good enough".
  • Tech-backed design knowledge. We make sure branding works both in print and on screen.
  • Quick turnaround. Most designs completed within 3 to 5 business days, with edits usually within 24 hours.
  • Clear, honest pricing. No surprise fees or confusing packages.
Add-On Services

Keep Your Brand Consistent Everywhere.

📱

Social Media Templates

Branded templates and logo resize packs for social platforms.

📧

Letterhead & Email Signature

Letterhead, invoice templates and email signatures with branding and links.

📘

Style Guide

A style guide so your brand stays consistent everywhere it appears.

🌐

New Website Design

Bring your new branding to your site, see our new website design service.

Related Services

Bring Your Whole Brand Together.

A new logo works best on a site to match, see our new website design and website redesign services. Once your branding is set, our SEO services help people find your business online.

Frequently Asked Questions

Your Questions, Answered.

Can you create a full branding package with matching logo, cards and pamphlets?

Yes, we offer cohesive branding packages where your logo, business cards and pamphlets all follow the same visual language, keeping your brand consistent across every material.

Do you offer logo files suitable for signage or vehicle wraps?

Yes, we provide high-resolution vector files like AI, SVG and EPS, ideal for large-format printing, signage and vehicle branding.

What's the difference between a vector logo and a raster logo?

A vector logo (AI, SVG) can be resized without losing quality, great for print. A raster logo (PNG, JPG) is pixel-based and best for digital screens. We supply both.

Can you recreate or modernise an old logo I already have?

Yes, we offer logo refresh services to modernise outdated designs, enhance readability, and prepare your logo in scalable formats.

Do I get full commercial usage rights?

Yes. After final approval and payment, you get full commercial usage rights, you own your design and can use it anywhere you like.

What's the typical turnaround time for a business card and logo combo?

Most projects are delivered within 3 to 5 business days, with revisions finalised in 7 to 10 business days depending on feedback.

Ready To Bring Your Brand To Life?

Get a free design quote for your logo, pamphlets or business cards.

Design My Brand
